transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. Let's get started with the round-robin updates before I publish the task-organization order for tomorrow's sustainment schedule. Airfield operations, signal, medical planning — please go ahead with your updates in that order. Once we've heard from all three, I'll issue the formal assignments for the airfield fuel sampling, radio-cable inspection, and clinic-generator testing tasks. We have three support teams available — Red, Blue, and Gold — and each task falls within the 0800-1200 work period.
